summary: Iteration 4 retest of the critical responsiveness defect + enquiry-ref atomic-counter fix. BACKEND: 23/23 PASS (21 original + 2 new concurrency/sequential ref uniqueness). 5 concurrent POST /api/enquiries produced 5 distinct, strictly consecutive refs; 3 sequential POSTs continued the sequence. FRONTEND responsiveness sweep (document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth) at widths 320/375/390/414/768/820/1024/1280/1366/1440/1920 across /, /checkout, /admin/login, /hampers/royal-exotic-basket, /hampers/daily-fresh-trio, /hampers/grand-emperor-hamper, /fruits, /fruits/vietnamese-red-pitaya, /fruits/chilean-bing-cherries: ZERO OVERFLOW ON ALL 9 x 11 = 99 datapoints. The original critical defect is FIXED. Visual regression at 375px and 1440px on /hampers/royal-exotic-basket and /fruits: no overlap, no clipped text, hero image contained, mobile sticky bar does not cover last content block. Functional regressions all pass: qty stepper (span not input — read via text_content), hamper-add-cart adds exact qty (3 added), hamper-express-buy navigates to /checkout, 3 tabs switch (front/inside/produce), produce tab shows hamper-produce-list + working hamper-policy-toggle/text, 6 shelf-add-hamper-* increment cart-count, 6 related-hamper-* present. Fruits page: fruit-variant-2 + fruit-add-bucket adds correct qty (6=2 pcs x 3), 8 shelf-add-* present, 3 fruit-tab-* render, fruit-quick-buy -> /checkout. E2E: added 1 hamper + 2 fruits -> /checkout with name TEST_E2E_Final / +919812345680 -> UF1014 success -> cart cleared (count=0) -> verified via admin API that enquiry UF1014 (total 2859) + customer +919812345680 (orders=1, LTV 2859) exist. 2 MINOR admin overflow regressions ONLY at exactly 1024px (not above/below) on /admin/inventory (sw=1060) and /admin/customers (sw=1080) — the admin-layout `lg:flex` sidebar+content splits exactly at 1024 but the content area holds a table whose min-content exceeds the remaining track; fine at 320-820 and 1280+.

issues: 36-56px horizontal overflow at viewport width exactly 1024 (lg breakpoint). document.documentElement.scrollWidth: /admin/inventory=1060, /admin/customers=1080; cw=1024. No overflow at 320-820 (sidebar collapses) or at >=1280 (plenty of room). The offender is `.min-h-screen bg-[#eaf6e4] lg:flex` wrapper combined with the admin table's intrinsic min-content width. Minor — tables inside already scroll, but at exactly 1024 the page itself scrolls sideways by ~36-56px. Fix: either wrap tables in `overflow-x-auto` with `min-w-0` on the content column, or push the sidebar-split breakpoint to >=1280 (`xl:flex`).

action_items: Minor: fix /admin/inventory and /admin/customers 36-56px horizontal overflow at viewport width exactly 1024px (add min-w-0 to admin content column OR change admin layout breakpoint from lg:flex to xl:flex OR add overflow-x-auto on the table wrapper).
critical_code_review_comments: Enquiry ref generator is now atomic via db.counters find_one_and_update (upsert, return_document=After) — concurrency test confirmed strictly unique + sequential refs across 5 parallel POSTs. Good.

/admin/* layout uses `lg:flex` which engages exactly at 1024px, where the fixed-width sidebar + full-width table exceed 1024 — same class of grid/flex intrinsic-sizing bug the hamper/fruit pages had. Prefer `xl:flex` for admin, or always include `min-w-0` + `overflow-x-auto` on the right-hand content column.

The HamperDetail/FruitDetail fix (grid-cols-1 default + min-w-0 on all three grid children + shelf strip w-full min-w-0 max-w-full) is correct; removing body overflow-x:hidden was the right move so future regressions are not masked.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% — only minor admin overflow at exactly 1024px remains

seed_data_creation: Created 10 TEST_ enquiries during this run (5 concurrent, 3 sequential, 1 regular test, 1 E2E UF1014). ALL 13 TEST_/SMOKE enquiries deleted via DELETE /api/admin/enquiries/{id} at end. 5 TEST_* customers (TEST_Buyer, TEST_StatusBuyer, TEST_Concurrent_102, TEST_E2E_Final, SMOKE Ref) remain in db — no admin DELETE endpoint for customers exists, upsert-by-phone keeps them persistent. If cleanup is required, add DELETE /api/admin/customers/{id} or wipe by phone-prefix script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The iteration-3 critical responsiveness defect is fully fixed — do not re-measure the 9 public pages. If you need to re-run, pytest backend_tests.py + test_enquiry_ref_concurrency.py (23 total) is the regression suite. Admin layout breakpoint quirk at exactly 1024px is the only unresolved minor issue. qty testid `hamper-qty` is a <span>, read with text_content (NOT input_value). Admin login: POST /api/admin/login (not /auth/login).
rca of the issue: Resolved: HamperDetail.jsx/FruitDetail.jsx now set `grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1.05fr_236px]`, apply `min-w-0` to all three grid children, and constrain the Gift/Harvest shelf horizontal strip with `flex w-full min-w-0 max-w-full gap-3 overflow-x-auto lg:grid lg:overflow-visible`. Backend enquiry ref generator was switched from count_documents-based to an atomic find_one_and_update on db.counters (_id='enquiry_ref', $inc:1, upsert, return_document=After), guaranteeing uniqueness and monotonic sequence under concurrent POSTs — verified with 5 parallel threads returning 5 distinct consecutive refs.
